# pg-plan-explainer

> Explain PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE JSON plans: exclusive time per node, the slowest nodes, and findings for filter-heavy scans, misestimates, disk sorts, hash batches and costly nested loops Python package `trysac-pg-plan-explainer`, import name `pg_plan_explainer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
